correctness.rationale: The polar cube edge-gradient model identifies every facet. The exact path variance inequality and strict replacement bound rule out all nonmonotone arms for every integer arm length. Monotone arms give the stated signed triangular-weight norm formula and exact contact count; antipodal symmetry proves unrestricted optimality. Orthogonality to all tight facets and strict slack for the others proves the center affine rank. The exact-arithmetic checker independently enumerates finite cases but is not substituted for the proof.
